Sharad Purnima 2026 Date and Significance

Sharad Purnima in 2026 will be observed on either October 25th or 26th. The festival is associated with traditions such as offering kheer (rice pudding) under moonlight, believed to be imbued with nectar from the moon god Chandra Dev.
